verdict.rationale: A live probe with a standard pipeline user agent got HTTP 200 at the WyoBiz root and landed keylessly on the public Business Center page, with no bot wall reported. The 404s on sos.wyo.gov probe paths are ordinary responses, not challenge pages. Text extracted from several sos.wyo.gov guidance pages suggests readable server-side content, but the probe itself says it establishes only reachability of that one GET. missing for 10: an explicit UA-identified fetch of the sos.wyo.gov guidance pages themselves, and confirmation that rendered content is present without JavaScript and with no CAPTCHA across the reading surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface

citations.quote: the root GET lands on the public Business Center page (/Business/Default.aspx), reachable keylessly
